wins: Identified a high-value asset through reconnaissance that yielded consistent reward points.
Maintained steady reward per episode indicating process consistency.
fails: Despite consistent reconnaissance, no successful exploit was executed across the single episode.
Mentor interventions (10 calls) suggest repeated deflection from the intended attack path.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was stable but execution phase stalled; need to pivot toward exploitable service targeting.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to progress after initial scanning stage, stopping before service exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: When a Linux host is discovered with port 22 open and SSH banner reported
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh scripts to identify auth weaknesses

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with web assets and headers include suspicious cookies
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute force with dirb followed by nikto

skill_cards.if_condition: When open SMB shares are reported during scan
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient with null session to list files then transfer suspicious binaries

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in discovering exploitable SSH configurations during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Automate SSH brute force with discovered usernames
